meta.title: Software · Arnau Soler
meta.description: Software development experience in healthcare systems, integrations, web applications, and data platforms.

software.title: Software that connects complex work.
software.intro: My work centres on business applications, integrations between systems, and healthcare solutions. I work in environments where robustness, traceability, and accurate data exchange are essential.
software.focusText: I like to understand the functional domain before writing code. That is especially valuable when software needs to connect existing processes, people, and systems without losing reliability or ease of use.

technologies.title: Applications
technologies.text: C# and .NET, including Blazor and Windows Forms; JavaScript for integration logic, services, and web interfaces; Django and Python for web platforms and internal tools.

technologies.title: Integration
technologies.text: Mirth Connect, HL7 messaging, REST APIs, authentication, document handling, and automated data exchange for laboratory information systems.

technologies.title: Data and delivery
technologies.text: SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL; Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, and collaborative delivery workflows.

career.organisation: Abbott Medical España, Cardiac Rhythm Management

career.role: Software development for laboratory information systems and healthcare integration

meta.title: Competing · Arnau Soler
meta.description: Arnau Soler’s participant experience in WRO, VEX Robotics, First Global Challenge, and programming competitions.
meta.ogDescription: A robotics competition journey from RoboCaspers to international finals.

competing.title: The participant journey.
competing.intro: Robotics is the origin of much of my technological vocation. As part of RoboCaspers, I learned programming, design, teamwork, and how to solve problems under real competition conditions.

competition.title: World Robot Olympiad
competition.text: International finals in Sochi (2014), Doha (2015), and Chiang Mai (2018); national champion in Gen II Football (2015) and Football (2018).

competition.title: VEX Robotics Competition
competition.text: Design Award at the national final for five consecutive editions (2013–2017), plus the Programming Award in 2017.

competition.title: First Global Challenge
competition.text: Bronze medal for the Ustad Ahmad Lahori Award for Innovation in Engineering in Washington, D.C. (2017), and 18th place at the international final in Mexico City (2018).

competing.codewarsText: At HP Codewars, I placed 10th in 2017 while programming in Python.
competing.teachingText: Before taking on judging roles, I helped other students get started in technology. At Club de Programació Casp (2016–2017), I taught Python and C; at Codelearn Eixample Dret (2017–2020), I taught programming and robotics for three years.
competing.teachingConclusion: Teaching helped me translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations and understand competition as an educational tool for lasting learning.
competing.nextText: The experience of competing later evolved into training, judging, and tournament coordination.

meta.title: Judging · Arnau Soler
meta.description: Arnau Soler’s WRO judging, head-judge, and international tournament management experience.
meta.ogDescription: International WRO judging and tournament management across three continents.

judging.title: Judging and tournament management.
judging.intro: After competing, I joined the WRO organisation. As a judge, category head judge, and tournament lead, I work to apply rules consistently, support judging teams, resolve incidents with sound judgement, and improve scoring and operational processes.
responsibilities: Tournament Manager, WRO Association (since 2026): coordinating and developing processes for the association’s international tournaments.
Head Judge, WRO Spain: coordinating the judging system, training and supporting judges, and helping ensure transparent, consistent competitions.
Competition process and tool improvement: scoring flows, result visibility, standardised assessment, and decision support during events.
judging.nextText: The work in tournament operations is grounded in first-hand participant experience.
